programme.title: My Haunted House: The Hitchhiker and The Widow
programme.desc: Strange things happen after a girl and her friends pick up a hitchhiker in the woods.

programme.title: My Haunted House: Don't Fall Asleep and The Double Walker
programme.desc: A woman starts to mimic the bizarre behavior that led to her fiance's mysterious death. A couple experiences the horrifying legend of the Double Walker firsthand.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Melody Thomas Scott
programme.desc: Young and the Restless actress Melody Thomas Scott returns to the home in Sherman Oaks, California she fled decades ago after a face to face meeting with a desperate spirit.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Travis Tritt
programme.desc: Country music legend, Travis Tritt is living in fear of the inexplicable paranormal experiences he is having at his lakeside cabin nestled in the Blue Ridge Mountains of Georgia.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Harry Lennix
programme.desc: Actor Harry Lennix (The Blacklist, Dollhouse, The Matrix Reloaded) returns to the notoriously haunted hotel in Eureka Springs, Arkansas.

programme.title: The Night Of The Hunter
programme.desc: Robert Mitchum stars in an unforgettable role as a psychopathic preacher in relentless pursuit of two children who have their dead father's stolen fortune hidden in a doll. Shelley Winters co-stars.

programme.title: The Little Shop Of Horrors
programme.desc: En butiksanställd upptäcker en mystisk växt med en blodtörstig aptit. Framgång följer, men priset visar sig vara människoliv, och situationen eskalerar.

programme.title: The Killing of a Sacred Deer: The Killing of a Sacred Deer
programme.desc: Kirurgen Steven verkar utåt sett lycklig med sin familj, men är samtidigt bäste vän med sextonårige Martin som verkar ha någon hållhake på sin vän; frågan är vad den udda vänskapen grundar sig i, och vad den kan få för konsekvenser.

programme.title: Juliet, Naked
programme.desc: Duncans brutalt uttråkade flickvän Annie har aldrig insett Crowes storhet. Ett oväntat snedsteg leder till att Annie och Duncan gör slut, samtidigt som en oslipad version av Tucker Crowes mest kända album kommer ut.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In Las Vegas, a gang of robbers target an ATM repository and hit the jackpot. Their take was over a million dollars in cash, the largest heist in Las Vegas history.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 1970's South America faced a surge of political kidnappings and assassinations. When the killings spilled onto U.S. soil it was time for the FBI to step in.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Perfect Heist
programme.desc: Bank robbery is a brazen yet simple crime. A mask, a gun, a note passed to a teller. But bank burglary is different. It takes skill to disable an alarm, to penetrate a locked vault.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: I Feel Pretty
programme.desc: Amy Schumer spelar rollen som Renee, en ung kvinna som varje dag febrilt försöker övervinna sin osäkerhet och sin känsla av otillräcklighet.

programme.title: Mousehunt
programme.desc: Bröderna Lars och Ernie Smuntz har haft en rad motgångar och tror inte särskilt mycket på den gamla herrgården de ärver – tills de upptäcker att den förfallna fastigheten i själva verket är värd miljoner.

programme.title: Taken 3
programme.desc: Liam Neeson är tillbaka som Bryan Mills. Men denna gång är det han själv som hamnar i knipa då han blir jagad för ett mord han inte begått.

programme.title: TAKEN
programme.desc: Bryan, en före detta CIA-agent har svårt att släppa sin gamla yrkesroll och ser faror överallt. När hans dotter, Kim, åker till Paris, besannas hans värsta mardröm, hon kidnappas.

programme.title: Certified Copy
programme.desc: En kvinna och en författare utforskar identitet och kärlek i Toscana. Romantik med Juliette Binoche.

programme.title: Mutant X: Hon har blivit oskadliggjord
programme.desc: Mutant X-teamet upptäcker att deras lagkamrat Lexa är föremål för ett hemligt experiment som kontrollerar henne och ger sig ut på jakt efter den ansvariga läkaren.

programme.title: Mutant X: Drömälskare
programme.desc: Mutant X måste stoppa en vetenskapsman från att klona kvinnor för att använda dem som slavar i sin ultraexklusiva mansklubb.

programme.title: Mutant X: Profetian
programme.desc: Brennan kämpar tillsammans med en av profetians väktare för att stoppa den avlidne mutanten Ashlockes plan fra bortom världsherraväldens grav.

programme.title: Mutant X: Cirque des Merveilles
programme.desc: Lexas misstankar leder till att Mutant X avslöjar ett resande dödsläger som är utformat som en cirkus för mutantflyktingar och Mutant X:s fiende inom Dominion.

programme.title: Mutant X: Överfallet
programme.desc: Många av mysterierna kring Mutant X avslöjas när Lexa och Jesse tillfångatas av Dominion och teamet, tillsammans med Adam, går in för att rädda dem.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Military Justice
programme.desc: The Naval Criminal Investigative Service uses forensic science to solve three perplexing murders and fulfill their motto: "To the living we owe respect; to the dead, we owe the truth."

programme.title: The New Detectives: Medical Examiners's Casebook
programme.desc: Some killers choose to hide their victims. And investigators must then rely on forensic examiners to uncover proof of murder. These are just two extraordinary crimes that have made their way into the medical examiner's casebook.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Raw Greed
programme.desc: A friendly Midwest lodge becomes the scene of a gruesome double murder. Two men are dead and a safe filled with cash is missing.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Silent Witness
programme.desc: Three hairs, microscopic fibers, a common trash bag ripped from a roll. Seemingly small and insignificant clues become a victim's silent witness.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: One Down, Two to Go
programme.desc: Tired of Al escorting her dates out through the doorway, "grown-up" Kelly gets her own apartment.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: And Baby Makes Money
programme.desc: After Al's bachelor uncle dies, he leaves $500,000 to the first of his relatives to produce a newborn baby named after him. Al overcomes his usual aversion to sex with Peg.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Married…with Who
programme.desc: After a drinking binge at a bankers party, Marcy reveals herself to be married to a mysterious hunk named Jefferson D'Arcy, whom Al finds out to be a gigolo and con artist.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Look Who's Barking
programme.desc: Told from the point of view of Buck, he runs away from the house feeling neglected. Behind a diner, he picks up a female dog, whom he brings home. He quickly regrets it, as the new dog gets all the attention from Bud and Kelly.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: The Godfather
programme.desc: Al becomes the boss of the neighborhood after Kelly starts dating an influential city councilman.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: A Man's Castle
programme.desc: Peg takes an interior design course and her first assignment is to redecorate one room in her house. Unfortunately for Al, she chooses his spare bathroom.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: All Night Security Dude
programme.desc: When a second floor aerobics studio, full of terribly overweight women, collapses into the shoe store, Al is laid off while the store is being repaired. Al then gets a night job as a security guard at his old high school, Polk High.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Weenie Tot Lovers & Other Strangers
programme.desc: Al forgoes giving money to Bud for a class trip to Washington DC in order to give to Kelly who's going to an audition for the Miss Weenie Tot spokesperson. When Kelly lands the spot, Al gets a year's supply of his favorite mock food: Weenie Tots.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Oldies but Young 'Uns
programme.desc: Al is haunted by a tune on the radio he can hum but not name, and he gets no help from Peggy or the D'Arcy's.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: You Better Shop Around - Pt 1
programme.desc: Al cannot afford to buy an air conditioner for the hot summer. After an attempt to install an old experimental model, (which results in a neighborhood blackout) Al moves his family into the local supermarket.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Candy Sale / To the Rescue
programme.desc: Beavis and Butt-head sell chocalate bars for their school. Well, the chocolate bars practically sell themselves. / Beavis and Butt-head witness a plane crash and appear in a cheesy reenactment on "Rescue 911."

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Crisis line / Career day
programme.desc: Beavis and Butt-Head set out to support callers on a crisis line / Later they go out on work experience as security guards

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Sporting goods / Cow tipping
programme.desc: Beavis and Butt-Head decide to get athletic gear supporters for gym class / The duo venture out on a quest for cow tipping

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Give Blood / Beware of the Butt (aka Drive-In #1)
programme.desc: Beavis & Butt-head explore the career possibilities in selling blood. / While causing mischief at a drive-in movie theatre, Beavis & Butt-head experience a new phase of the moon.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Scared Straight / Citizen Butt-head Part 2
programme.desc: To teach them that crime doesn't pay, Beavis & Butt-head's principal sends them to prison for a day. Bad idea. / Beavis & Butt-head and President Clinton explore chaos theory together.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Murder Site / Sexual Harassment
programme.desc: Beavis can't take Butt-head's verbal abuse anymore, and snaps while they're checking out the site of a local murder. / Beavis and Butt-head sue Kimberly for sexual harassment, since she's giving them wood.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Take a number / Stewart moves away / Premature evacuation
programme.desc: The duo goes to rock concert / Beavis and Butt-Head breaks into Stewarts house to watch TV / A bomb threat is called into their high school

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: A great day / Bride of Butt-Head / Special delivery
programme.desc: The school closes and makes the best day / Butt-Head phones in a mail-order bride / Burger World launches a home delivery service

programme.title: RENO 911!: Milkshake Man's Death
programme.desc: Reno District Attorney Mike Powers investigates the Sheriff's Department.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Investigation Concluded
programme.desc: District Attorney Mike Powers concludes his investigation of the Sheriff's Department, while Terry the prostitute takes off in Reno's police helicopter.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Released from Prison
programme.desc: Members of the Reno Sheriff's Department start new lives after getting kicked off the force.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Revenge of Mike Powers
programme.desc: The deputies enjoy their new lives in the private sector, but a specter from their past continues to haunt them.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Cop School
programme.desc: Some promising new recruits intimidate the team with their skills, and Wiegel has trouble making magic with her incarcerated boyfriend.

programme.title: RENO 911!: SARS Outbreak
programme.desc: Dangle, Jones and Wiegel lose it in quarantine after exposure to SARS, while the rest of the sheriffs hang out with kids' show host Reading Ron.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Fastest Criminal in Reno
programme.desc: The deputies try to catch the infamous Fast Eddie McLintock.

programme.title: RENO 911!: The Prefect of Wanganui
programme.desc: Kimball and Dangle escort the Prefect of Wanganui, Reno's sister city, around town; Junior and Wiegel struggle to stand out at the high school job fair.

programme.title: RENO 911!: ...And the Installation Is Free
programme.desc: Jones discovers the delights of fame after doing radio commercials for a carpeting company.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Hocus-Pocus and Frisby
programme.desc: A loud-mouthed braggart's boasts attract the attention of some aliens.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Gift
programme.desc: An alien who crash-lands into a remote mountain village stirs up the villagers' fears and animosity, but he befriends a little boy and gives him a mysterious present.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Jeopardy Room
programme.desc: Major Ivan Kuchenko is trapped inside a hotel room with Commissar Vassiloff, a hitman, and Boris, his assistant, in the room across the street. Vassiloff has planted a bomb in the room and Ivan must find it within three hours or be blown to bits.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Five Characters in Search of an Exit
programme.desc: A hobo, clown, bagpipe player, ballerina and military officer are trapped in a huge cylinder.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A World of Difference
programme.desc: Businessman Arthur Curtis discovers that life as he knows it doesn't really exist.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Silence
programme.desc: Annoyed by a club member's constant chatter, a man bets him he cannot remain silent for a year, living in a glass enclosure in the club basement.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Sounds and Silences
programme.desc: A man's wish to listen to loud noise backfires.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A Short Drink from a Certain Fountain
programme.desc: Trying to keep up with his younger wife, Harmon convinces his brother to inject him with an experimental youth serum.

programme.desc: The Harlan County Courthouse was both sanctuary and execution site. The town hub that witnessed a brutal revenge killing and countless trials of corrupt lawmen is the site of the country's most haunted building.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: The screams of Cassius Clay in his final days can still be heard reverberating through the walls of White Hall. Caretakers have had their belief in the supernatural shifted ever since they began spending time at the site.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: The Brennans’ legacy begins and ends in their enchanting Old Louisville home: nearly every member of the Brennan clan perished within its walls or had their funeral service held here.

programme.title: The Bat
programme.desc: A country mansion full of guests soon becomes the playground of a killer after a hidden stash of embezzled money. The guests begin to disappear one by one as The Bat's identity is closer to being discovered.

programme.title: The Ape
programme.desc: A mad scientist trying to cure polio must obtain human spinal fluid, and resorts to nefarious means by wearing an ape suit to procure victims for his experiment without being detected.

programme.title: The Devil Bat
programme.desc: Dr. Paul Carruthers is cheated by his employers after developing a new aftershave lotion, so he seeks revenge by using a giant killer bat to kill anyone wearing the lotion.

programme.title: My One And Only
programme.desc: En hårt arbetande mamma tar med sina barn på en utmanande roadtrip efter mannens svek.

programme.title: Brad's Status
programme.desc: Under en resa börjar Brad fundera på ungdomsvännernas rika och glamorösa tillvaro. Hans bekväma och trevliga medelklassliv bleknar i jämförelse. Besvikelsen tar överhanden och han börjar ifrågasätta hur bra hans liv egentligen är.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Blood Brothers
programme.desc: When the small community of Noel, Missouri discovered their bank was robbed, they're shocked. When the bank president turned up missing, they're outraged. And when clues began to surface the facts were more terrible than anyone could have guessed.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska
programme.desc: The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 1970s, cities across the United States became a battleground for vicious Croatian radicals. Their violent agenda targeted their own people living in America.

programme.title: Chloe & Theo
programme.desc: Chloe, en ung kvinna som lever på gatan i New York, möter den vise inuiten Theo, som har skickats till New York av sina ”äldste” för att överlämna ett budskap till världen.

programme.title: Boys And Girls
programme.desc: Ryan (Freddie Prinze, Jr.) och Jennifer (Claire Forlani) kunde inte vara mer olika. Som barn stod de inte ut med varandra. Som vuxna är det deras olikheter som knyter dem samman i den här roliga romantiska komedin från regissören till SHE'S ALL THAT.

programme.title: The Big White
programme.desc: För att lindra sina ekonomiska problem söker en anställd på en resebyrå efter ett fruset lik, som råkar vara eftertraktat av två mördare.

programme.title: Till Death
programme.desc: Efter en romantisk kväll i deras hus nere vid sjön vaknar Emma fängslad vid sin döde man. Avskuren från allt mitt i vintern måste hon värja sig mot lejda mördare för att kunna undfly sin mans sjuka plan.

programme.title: Snedseglarna
programme.desc: Komisk action och många snytingar när Terence Hill och Bud Spencer går på skattjakt! Alan (Terence Hill) är en obotlig gambler som en dag spelar bort maffians pengar och måste fly för livet.

programme.title: Cary Grant - Charade
programme.desc: Cary Grant & Audrey Hepburn i superb thriller

programme.title: Andromeda: Under natten
programme.desc: Efter att ha blivit strandsatt nära ett svart hål blir kapten Dylan Hunt upptäckt av ett bärgningsfartyg och upptäcker att han har varit frusen i tiden i 300 år.

programme.title: Andromeda: En bekräftande flamma
programme.desc: Dylan skyddar Andromeda från legosoldater medan Beka börjar undra om de kämpar för fel sida.

programme.title: Andromeda: Att förlora den avgörande blixten
programme.desc: Dylan hittar en rymdstation full av barn som tror att han är där för att skapa fred genom att döda sina fiender.

programme.title: Andromeda: D minus noll
programme.desc: Andromedas besättning håller fortfarande på att lära sig att arbeta tillsammans när de attackeras av Återställarna.

programme.title: Mutant X: Chocken av det nya (pilot)
programme.desc: En mutant empatiker som är på flykt från mystiska regeringsagenter räddas av ett team av andra " Nya mutanter ", gruppen Mutant X.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped
programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Blood Money
programme.desc: Some people murder for love. But these killers did it for the money. When greed is the motive, investigators must make every clue pay off.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Coroner's Casebook
programme.desc: A good coroner provides what's necessary to solve a crime. A bad one can spoil an otherwise rock-solid case. Cyril Wecht and Henry Lee, two of the country's most respected coroners, share their cases and insights into crime solving.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Absent Witness
programme.desc: When killers hide or destroy the remains of their victims, it becomes the mission of forensic scientists to reconstruct the scenes and prove murder for an absent witness.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Dead Men Do Talk
programme.desc: Profiles the work of world-renowned forensic experts and the procedures they use to solve murders and other mysteries in minutes or centuries after they happen.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: If Al Had a Hammer

programme.title: RENO 911!: Clemmy Marries a Dead Guy

programme.title: RENO 911!: Garcia's Secret Girlfriend

programme.title: RENO 911!: Dangle's Son
programme.desc: While Dangle spends time with a beautiful young man who might be his son, the other deputies enjoy the new department Humvee.

programme.title: RENO 911!: CSI: Reno

programme.title: RENO 911!: Naked Stake-Out

programme.title: RENO 911!: Wiegel and Craig Get Married

programme.title: RENO 911!: Wiegel's Pregnant

programme.title: RENO 911!: The Junior Bros.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Jet Ski Blues
programme.desc: The Reno Sheriff's Department inherits a beautiful, cursed jet ski from a fallen deputy.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Mirror

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Twenty-Two

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: I Shot an Arrow into the Air

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A Quality of Mercy
programme.desc: A gung-ho young soldier gets a new viewpoint on war when he inexplicably changes places with a Japanese officer trying to stop his superior from leading a charge against American forces.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Changing of the Guard

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Cavender is Coming

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Five Characters in Search of an Exit

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Fugitive
programme.desc: Old Ben, who is able to transform himself into anything, tries to help a crippled little girl.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A Piano in the House
programme.desc: Fortune discovers that a piano he bought his wife for her birthday has magical properties - the music that it plays makes people reveal their true essence.

programme.title: The FBI Files

programme.title: Octopus
programme.desc: A Russian sub is sunk while en route to Havana. The hold is breached and barrels full of some mysterious substance tumble out. Later, reports of a killer octopus surface.

programme.title: Hell Night
programme.desc: Four college pledges are forced to spend the night in a deserted old mansion, where they are stalked by the monstrous survivor of a family massacre years earlier.

programme.title: Body Bags [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A creepy-looking coroner (John Carpenter) introduces three different horror tales involving his current work which are cadavers in "body bags."

programme.title: Flight 666
programme.desc: Passengers on an international flight are attacked by unseen forces. As they fight to stay alive, they realize who is controlling the attacks.

programme.title: The Pit
programme.desc: A solitary and strange preteen boy wreaks vengeance on his harassers when he makes a disturbing discovery in the depths of a forest.

programme.title: A Bucket of Blood
programme.desc: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark. Elvira tries her hand at being an artist in a variety of mediums. Also, Breather presents the Mistress of the Dark with The Publisher's Wet T-Shirt Contest Award.

programme.title: Shark Attack 3: Megalodon
programme.desc: In the third installment of the "Shark Attack" saga, marine researchers make a startling discovery: the most menacing beast that ever ruled these waters is still alive.

programme.title: House of Bones
programme.desc: A team of TV ghost hunters travel to investigate a haunted house surrounded by rumors. Upon their arrival, they find a foreboding house with a mind of its own. With Corin Nemec ("Stargate SG-1") and Charisma Carpenter ("Angel").

programme.title: Alligator II: The Mutation
programme.desc: A police detective (Joseph Bologna) teams up with a Cajun hunter (Richard Lynch) to find a giant killer-reptile in the city sewers.

programme.title: Alligator [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A baby alligator is flushed down a Chicago toilet and survives by eating discarded laboratory rats injected with growth hormones.

programme.title: House (1985) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A mounted fish moves, household objects levitate, and monsters haunt a troubled novelist (William Katt).

programme.title: Apollo 18
programme.desc: Apollo 17 was the last U.S.-sponsored lunar voyage -- or was it? Hours of found footage, classified for decades, point to a subsequent moon mission -- Apollo 18 -- that ended very badly. Astronauts John Grey (Ryan Robbins), Nathan Walker (Lloyd Owen) and Benjamin Anderson (Warren Christie), on a mission to install radar scanners, discover a Soviet space capsule nearby. The men also discover a dead cosmonaut, and unfortunately for them, learn how he died.

programme.title: Puppet Master
programme.desc: Assailed by nightmarish visions, Alex Whitaker (Paul Le Mat) and his fellow psychics descend on the Bodega Bay Inn. There, they discover that their compatriot Neil (Jimmie F. Scaggs) has apparently committed suicide. But, as the gruesome visions continue, they sense that there's still something sinister afoot. When they find themselves hunted by a band of homicidal marionettes created by twisted puppeteer Andre Toulon (William Hickey), they discover they're right.

programme.title: Curtains
programme.desc: Six young actresses auditioning for a movie role at a remote mansion are targeted by a mysterious masked murderer.

programme.title: Dead Awake
programme.desc: Kate Bowman is a by-the-books social worker who is investigating a series of mysterious deaths. Each victim suffered from sleep paralysis, a frightening ailment that immobilizes its victims as they dream. Kate is approached by an unorthodox doctor who warns of an evil entity that haunts people in their sleep. She brushes aside his admonition, but when a terrifying entity begins to haunt Kate's friends and loved ones, she must fight to stay awake to stop the nightmare she's unleashed.

programme.title: Hollow Creek
programme.desc: Trying to find inspiration for his next horror novel, Blake retreats to the Appalachian Mountains with his mistress, Angelica. When she disappears, Blake becomes a prime suspect.

programme.title: The Brain That Wouldn't Die
programme.desc: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark. Elvira prepares to compete on a game show while hosting "The Brain That Wouldn't Die."

programme.title: Eye See You
programme.desc: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one.

programme.title: Crocodile
programme.desc: A group of friends goes on a boat trip - but their joyful weekend turns into horror when a giant killer crocodile, searching for its stolen eggs, picks off anyone who gets in its way.

programme.title: Maneater
programme.desc: Townspeople must venture deep into the woods to save their isolated town from an escaped Bengal tiger.

programme.title: Dominion: Prequel To The Exorcist [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Haunted by terrible acts the Nazis forced him to participate in, the disenchanted Father Lankester Merrin focuses his energies on helping with an archaeological dig in the northern part of Kenya. There, the crew uncovers a church that predates Christian missions into the area, but the discovery also causes strange events to start occurring -- including physical changes to a young, disabled boy, whom Merrin grows to suspect has been possessed by a demon.

programme.title: Black Christmas [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: As winter break begins, a group of sorority sisters, including Jess (Olivia Hussey) and the often inebriated Barb (Margot Kidder), begin to receive anonymous, lascivious phone calls. Initially, Barb eggs the caller on, but stops when he responds threateningly. Soon, Barb's friend Clare (Lynne Griffin) goes missing from the sorority house, and a local adolescent girl is murdered, leading the girls to suspect a serial killer is on the loose. But no one realizes just how near the culprit is.

programme.title: The Vault
programme.desc: Some curious students visit an abandoned school and learn its shameful history isn't fully in the past. Their trip turns into a fight for survival.

programme.title: An American Werewolf in Paris
programme.desc: A group of carousing American tourists is taking in the cultural landmarks of Paris when a chance encounter results in sightseer Andy McDermott (Tom Everett Scott) saving the life of Parisian Serafine Pigot (Julie Delpy). While on a date at a nightclub with Serafine, Andy is suddenly attacked and bitten by a werewolf. The next day he discovers that Serafine is also a lycanthrope, and that he is beginning his own grueling, hirsute transformation into one of the fanged beasts.

programme.title: The Bone Snatcher
programme.desc: When four jewel hunters are found dead in the desert with the flesh stripped from their bodies, it's up to Dr. Zack Straker to find out what's gone wrong.

programme.title: Prom Night
programme.desc: This slasher movie follows a relentless killer who is out to avenge the death of a young girl who died after being bullied and teased by four of her classmates. Now high-school students, the guilt-ridden kids have kept their involvement a secret, but when they start being murdered, one by one, it's clear that someone knows the truth. Also coping with the past are members of the dead girl's family, most notably her prom-queen sister, Kim Hammond.

programme.title: Maniac Cop 2
programme.desc: Renegade police officer Matthew Cordell (Robert Z'Dar) once roamed the streets of New York City unleashing his murderous brand of vigilante justice upon its denizens before being struck down by good cop Jack Forrest (Bruce Campbell). Now, Forrest is eager to move on from those heinous events, but he is stopped short when a familiar killing spree begins. Though thought dead and gone, Cordell is back from the grave and ready to wreak his merciless havoc once more.

The Utah-based comic has made television appearances on A&E's An Evening at the Improv, nationally syndicated Comedy.TV, ABC's America's Funniest People and has established himself as a funny, improvisational comic, host, roastmaster and emcee.Keith tours nationally and has shared the stage with showbiz legends Joan Rivers, Jeff Foxworthy, Bill Cosby, Jim Gaffigan, Sinbad, Gladys Knight, and Frank Caliendo. Keith was one of five comedians who performed for the athletes in the Olympic Village at the 2002 Winter Games.Keith was named Best Actor by City Weekly for his show-stopping, comedic performance as 'Vinnie Black' in the stage production of Tony 'n Tina's Wedding. programme.title: Joe Dirt

Joe Dirt (David Spade) is a janitor with a mullet hairdo, acid-washed jeans and a dream -- to find the parents that he lost at the Grand Canyon when he was eight. As his wandering, misguided search takes him from one misadventure to another, he finds his way to Los Angeles, where a shock-jock (Dennis Miller) brings Joe on the radio to insult him. But as Joe's story unfolds, jeers turn to cheers, and an entire city is captivated.
